newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates quoted steady to lower on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates quoted steady to lower on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels on Friday at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. No barges traded versus one barge traded on Thursday.
- Two barges, this week, St Louis, Mississippi River, no bid, offered 160 percent, no comparison.
- Two barges, next week, Ohio River, bid 140 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio River, bid 140 percent, unchanged, offer 155 percent, down five percentage points.
- Eight barges, two each week of February, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi, no bid, offer 105 percent.
